# virtual-actors-lite

> Run Orleans-style virtual actors in process with on-demand single activation per key, turn-based mailboxes, etag-checked persistent state and durable reminders NuGet package `Trysac.VirtualActorsLite`, namespace `Trysac.VirtualActorsLite`, MIT
> licensed, .NET >= 10, base class library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
